sourceDocument.documentTitle: List of empanelled Hospitals of District Sonipat (Haryana) under AB-PMJAY as on 03/08/2026

inspection.method: PDF text extraction and visual inspection of pages 1-3
inspection.observedCoverage: The PDF lists entry number, hospital ID, hospital name, type, email, nodal officer name, and contact number. It does not show facility street addresses, registration numbers, or explicit links between similar entries.
inspection.limitations: Separate roster entries and different source IDs establish that the source lists separate records; they do not by themselves establish whether the records refer to one or multiple real-world facilities.
